Terms of Participation, Health Waiver, and Privacy Notice

By creating an account and registering for this 5-week training program, you acknowledge and agree to the following:

1. Voluntary Health & Safety Assumption of Risk

Not Medical Advice: The exercises provided in this program are for general educational and physical training purposes only and do not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

Assumption of Risk: Physical exercise carries inherent risks, including muscle strain, injury, or severe medical events. You confirm that you are participating voluntarily and at your own risk.

Waiver of Liability: You agree to fully release, discharge, and hold harmless the operators, owners, instructors, and developers of this program from any claims, liability, damages, or injuries arising from or related to your participation.

Medical Clearance: If you have any pre-existing health conditions, dizziness, heart conditions, or mobility limits, you are strongly advised to consult a physician before starting. Stop exercising immediately if you feel pain, faintness, or discomfort.

2. Data Security & Information Usage

Data Storage: We implement reasonable safety measures to protect your basic account information and self-reported performance metrics. However, no online system or electronic storage is completely secure.

Disclaimer of Data Guarantee: By using this online platform, you acknowledge that the operators and owners do not guarantee absolute data security and shall not be held liable for unauthorized access, data loss, or technical breaches beyond reasonable control.

3. General Service Agreement

This program is provided on an "as-is" and "as-available" basis without warranties of any kind, explicit or implied. The operators reserve the right to modify or discontinue content at any time.

Agreement: I am 18+ and agree to the Health Waiver, Liability Release, and Privacy Terms. (Required to register)
